# B308 Next Step Plan
Дата: 13.09.2026

## Priority 1 — whole-organism policy influence
Measure and selectively strengthen the bridge from adaptive policy ranking into final action selection only where evidence shows the policy signal is drowned by redundant/overlapping sources. Do not globally multiply the bias. First identify duplicates/overlap among policy sources.

## Priority 2 — longer sequence credit
Extend the B308 short trace from one-step prior credit to a bounded 2–3 step causal trace only after the one-step result survives long-horizon regression. Reuse existing P23/P28 replay where possible; do not create another replay store.

## Priority 3 — Android/Termux hardware run
Run `scripts/run-b305-termux-benchmark.sh` on the target phone and capture real RSS/latency/thermal/battery.

## Priority 4 — verification debt
Target the critical decision path first instead of randomly increasing VERIFIED function count.

## Non-goal
Do not add another generic neural or personality subsystem in B309 while canonical policy/causal links remain underused.
